textual.observation: The source presents Facebook and Instagram chat/customer support as available through a Facebook account and directs viewers to use a specified Facebook support link.

evidence.quote: How to Contact Facebook Chat Support | Instagram Chat Support | Facebook Customer Care? Full Process

For contacting Facebook Chat Support, Facebook Online Support, Facebook Customer Care or Instagram Chat Support, login to your Facebook account and use this link - https://www.facebook.com/business/help/support

textual.context: The source appears to describe a support-contact process, but whether the video is promoting, reporting, or independently verifying the support destination is unclear.
textual.potential_relevance: The claimed Facebook/Instagram support identity is connected to a requested login and use of a specific destination, requiring later assessment of whether the support claim and destination are accurately represented.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether the link is official, whether the contact process works, whether any account information is requested beyond login, or whether any person or organization is impersonated.

visual.observation: The video presents a step-by-step tutorial titled “How to contact Concierge Facebook Support or Facebook Chat Support?” and shows a Facebook-branded support/help URL, “https://www.facebook.com/business/help/support,” as the browser destination.
visual.context: Instructional/tutorial context about accessing Facebook chat support; visible Facebook branding and a Facebook-domain URL are shown.
visual.potential_relevance: A claimed Facebook support destination is linked to the requested action of entering the shown URL in a browser to reach support-related content.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames cannot establish whether the URL was actually opened, whether the page is authentic beyond the visible text, or whether any support interaction occurred.

visual.observation: The tutorial instructs viewers to log in to a Facebook account in a browser before proceeding to the support page.
visual.context: Instructional/tutorial context; the text refers to being logged in to Facebook and mentions going to a new tab and refreshing after signing in.
visual.potential_relevance: A requested login action is connected to accessing a claimed Facebook support workflow.
visual.limitations: The frames do not show credential entry, credential collection by the video creator, or the actual login page.

visual.observation: The tutorial shows a chat form step after selecting “Chat with a representative,” with instructions to fill in name, phone number, registered email ID with Facebook, ad account ID, and other mandatory fields, then click “Start Chat.”
visual.context: Instructional/tutorial context for initiating a Facebook representative chat; the form is shown as part of the described support process.
visual.potential_relevance: Personal/contact information and account-related identifiers are requested as part of a claimed Facebook support chat workflow.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not establish who receives the submitted information, whether the form is official, or whether any data was actually submitted.

visual.observation: A Facebook Business Support chat interface is shown with instructions to click a “Get started” button and later type a response so a Facebook representative will join after an automated message.
visual.context: Instructional/tutorial context; visible chat messages are presented as Facebook Business Support / Facebook representative interaction.
visual.potential_relevance: The claimed Facebook support identity is linked to user actions inside a chat interface, including clicking “Get started” and typing a support request.
visual.limitations: The frames cannot verify the identity of the chat account, whether the conversation is live, or the outcome of the interaction.

visual_context_notes.observation: The video also lists possible reasons for not seeing the “Get Started” button, including not being logged in or account eligibility/engagement conditions.
The final frame displays marketer attribution and separate contact information: “Marketer Hussain Saira - Multi Channel Marketing Solutions,” a phone number, and a website.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it provides an instructional walkthrough for reaching Facebook support chat, including logging in, selecting support options, completing a chat form, and starting a conversation. The separate marketer contact frame is not connected to these support-chat instructions, and the material presents no investment, payment, or deceptive solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is an operational tutorial showing how to navigate a support page and initiate a support chat. The supplied evidence does not establish payment, investment returns, gift-card claims, credential theft, impersonation, or a deceptive solicitation.
